item.title: US halts some Medicaid payments to Minnesota, alleging fraud
item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters) — The Trump administration is withholding more than a quarter of a million dollars of Medicaid funding from Minnesota, saying the state allowed the theft of federal funds intended for social-welfare programs in the state. The post US halts some Medicaid payments to Minnesota, alleging fraud appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Fiji official declares drug situation a national emergency
item.description: SUVA (FBC News/Pacnews) — Fiji's Minister for Policing and Communications Ioane Naivalurua has described Fiji’s illicit drug situation as a national emergency, warning that urgent action is needed to protect communities and young people. The post Fiji official declares drug situation a national emergency appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CHCC denies allegations in wrongful-death lawsuit
item.description: THE Commonwealth Healthcare Corp. has formally denied allegations that its staff acted negligently in treating a 64‑year‑old woman who died on Feb. 9, 2024, following a fall and rapid medical decline at the local hospital. The post CHCC denies allegations in wrongful-death lawsuit appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: CHCC’s $30M debt to CUC may take 17 years to clear
item.description: THE Commonwealth Healthcare Corp. will be able to pay off its arrears in approximately 17 years if the hospital stays current on its bills and consistently meets its minimum monthly payments, Assistant Attorney General Tina Ngo said in a recent status report to the federal court. The post CHCC’s $30M debt to CUC may take 17 years to clear appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.

item.title: Senate follows House, overrides budget vetoes
item.description: THE Senate on Thursday followed the House of Representatives’ override of several of Gov. David M. Apatang’s line-item vetoes on the revised fiscal year 2026 budget during its session at the Rota Mayor’s Office. The provisions vetoed are now law. item.title: Apatang to reinstate Cabrera, Macaranas
item.description: GOVERNOR David M. Apatang on Friday said he will reinstate the Office of Grants Management administrator, Epi Cabrera, and former Department of Public Safety Commissioner Anthony I. Macaranas, reversing termination letters issued last week by Lt. Gov. Dennis Mendiola while Apatang was off-island.
